beats.text: Who's the boss when the boss dies?
beats.say: In a cluster, one node has to be the boss. But who decides, and what happens when the boss dies?
The leader sends regular heartbeats to prove it's alive.

beats.text: No heartbeat? A follower's timer runs out.
beats.say: If the leader crashes, the heartbeats stop. Each follower has a timer, and the first one to run out takes action.

beats.text: It becomes a candidate and asks for votes.
beats.say: That follower becomes a candidate, and asks everyone else for their vote.

beats.text: A majority wins: only one leader, ever.
beats.say: Whoever gets a majority of votes becomes the new leader. A majority guarantees there can only ever be one.

beats.text: Terms stop an old leader from taking over.
beats.say: Each election has a term number. So if the old leader comes back, it sees a newer term, and steps down.

beats.text: Next up: distributed locks. Follow for more!
beats.say: Next up, distributed locks. Follow for more system design.
